CustomField.description: Formula to write the Renewal Postcard visualforce page. Pacificpoint 20210125AZ 00012549
CustomField.formula: CASE(SelectRenewalPostcard__c,"Renewal Postcard",IF(LicenseType__r.BoardProgram__r.Name =="MOTOR VEHICLE INDUSTRY LICENSING BOARD", "MVIPostcard", IF(LicenseType__r.BoardProgram__r.Name =="BOARD OF NURSING", "NursingPostcard", If(LicenseType__r.BoardProgram__r.Name== "REAL ESTATE COMMISSION","REBPostcard", "LicensePostcard"))), "Renewal Flyer", IF(LicenseType__r.BoardProgram__r.Name =="HAWAII MEDICAL BOARD", "MedicalFlyer", IF(LicenseType__r.BoardProgram__r.Name =="CONTRACTORS LICENSE BOARD", "CTFlyer", If(Name== "DOS","DOSFlyer", ""))), "Renewal Reminder", IF(LicenseType__r.BoardProgram__r.Name =="REAL ESTATE COMMISSION", "REBReminder", IF(LicenseType__r.BoardProgram__r.Name =="BOARD OF NURSING", "NursingReminder", If(LicenseType__r.BoardProgram__r.Name== "HAWAII MEDICAL BOARD","MedicalReminder", IF(LicenseType__r.BoardProgram__r.Name =="CONTRACTORS LICENSE BOARD","CTReminder",IF(LicenseType__r.BoardProgram__r.Name =="MOTOR VEHICLE INDUSTRY BOARD","MVIReminder","LicenseReminder"))))), "")
CustomField.label: Postcard Content
